messages:
sophie (Finance): heads up — HelixAI flagged invoice INV-2026-0789, says a promo credit didn't apply and the bill spiked 4.8x overnight. Can we reconcile?

rebecca (CS): saw this earlier when I pulled the account. They ran a performance experiment last week but promo was supposed to cover test traffic through 3/15. Customer says promo code PROMO-SPRING2026 not applied.

omar (AccountOps): thanks @rebecca. Can you paste the account id and last 24h usage snapshot?

rebecca (CS): account: helixai-prod (acct_94jx). Quick snippet from billing export:
```
2026-03-25T02:00Z, acct_94jx, tokens=1,250,324
2026-03-25T03:00Z, acct_94jx, tokens=5,980,112
2026-03-25T04:00Z, acct_94jx, tokens=6,104,001
```
Notable jump at 03:00 UTC when they kicked off the experiment.

sophie (Finance): raw delta ~+4.9M tokens in that window. Estimated charge = $0.022/token * 4,853,776 ≈ $106,782 (rough calc). Promo should have covered up to 5M tokens for the month.

billing-bot: promo PROMO-SPRING2026 attached? NO. Last applied promo: NONE. (checked: 2 rules matched; promo expired 2026-02-28).

omar (AccountOps): looks like the promo on the portal expired and CS had a private arrangement that wasn't reflected in billing rules. We should consider a manual adjustment. What does CS recommend?

rebecca (CS): customer expects a goodwill adjustment — they ran a backfill stress test and assumed promo still valid because of an email thread with our AE. I'd propose: apply a manual credit for the portion up to 5M tokens ($~110k), then bill any overage. If leadership ok, send a formal credit note.

sophie (Finance): propose a two-part action: 1) temporary credit of $110k to clear customer frustration, 2) open a follow-up to reconcile AE comms and decide final disposition (possible partial cap). Need Raj approval for >$50k credit. Also need GL code and JIRA to track.

raj (Revenue): +1 to helping the customer but want accountability. Approve temporary goodwill credit of $110,000 as a one-time manual adjustment. Please: (a) create billing adjustment with reason "promo-mismatch-goodwill"; (b) tag GL 4-2100-credits; (c) notify AR and mark as pending until we confirm AE email.

omar (AccountOps): will create the adjustment and PR. Quick Q: do we issue a credit invoice or zero-out the invoice?

sophie (Finance): issue a credit memo referencing INV-2026-0789 and link to the manual adjustment. Also create JIRA FIN-4821 for the root-cause (promo lifecycle gap).

rebecca (CS): I'll escalate the AE thread and attach screenshots. Also looping in the customer with a short note: "we're applying a goodwill credit while we investigate" — want to avoid losing the account.

sophie (Finance): tagging tasks: @omar will create credit memo + GL entry; @rebecca will provide AE evidence + customer note; @raj will sign off (done). Omar, please paste the adjustment id when done.

omar (AccountOps): creating adjustment now — ADJ-2026-3347. Credit memo CM-2026-122 attached to INV-2026-0789. GL 4-2100 posted. Posting note to customer thread.

billing-bot: adjustment ADJ-2026-3347 recorded by omar. Audit ref: CM-2026-122.

sophie (Finance): perfect. Closing loop: please add the promo lifecycle fixes to FIN-4821 and assign to platform billing team. Thanks all. :tada:

rebecca (CS): I sent the customer note and attached the credit memo. They replied :heart: — said appreciate the quick turnaround.

omar (AccountOps): final: moved $110,000 credit to AR hold until we get AE email doc, then release. Marking thread resolved.
